title: ste-check config
description: Configuration for ste-check, an unofficial Simplified Technical English checker.

$schema.description: The path or URL of this schema.

type.description: The default text type. Use -p or -d to change it for one run.

maxWords.description: The maximum number of words in a sentence, for each text type.

rules.description: Turn rules on (true) or off (false). All rules are on by default.

max-sentence-length.description: Sentences must not have more words than maxWords.

no-unapproved-words.description: Flag complex words, idioms, and phrasal verbs, and suggest simpler alternatives.

no-passive.description: Flag passive voice, such as "must be removed".

no-perfect-tense.description: Flag perfect tenses, such as "have removed".

words.description: More words or phrases to flag, with the alternative to suggest. Example: { "spin up": "start" }

allowIng.description: More -ing words to allow, such as "caching".

ignore.description: Words or phrases that no rule flags, such as product names or "kick off".
